message: XVatsim 1.0.3 is available. Download the update from X-Plane.org.
release_notes: Added a weighted brain evidence ledger for terminal APP/DEP controller relevance.
Prevents one terminal-owner text mismatch from hiding a controller when VATSIM, radio, route, and source authority evidence support displaying it.
Includes FAA/NASR airport frequency evidence as low-weight context while treating FAA misses as neutral for VATSIM pseudo-frequency cases.
Reports score, votes, neutral facts, evidence families, confidence, and final display/hide action in controller relevance diagnostics.
Shows the installed version on the overlay and plugin menu so pilots can confirm the active build without running a manual update check.
